blocks.html:
Vehicle Decals

This is the first of 3 vans that Surgically Clean Air has commissioned Vinyl Wrap Toronto to add Decals. The first one is a Ram Promaster City, a useful vehicle for deliveries and cargo. Adding Vehicle Decals is normally quicker than a partial or a full wrap.
The part of the installation that takes time is measuring and pre-masking. To ensure that each side matches and that the Vehicle Decals replicate the proofs, multiple measurements need to be taken. Our installation crew has multiple years of experience and has learned what points to use when measuring. The pre-masking is done so the graphics stay in place as per the design. If we did not pre-mask before installation, our crew would have to place each piece of vinyl individually. This would result in more time spent and more chances for mistakes. We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto pride ourselves that every wrap is done perfectly. The Surgically Clean Air van now stands out with the Black and grey decals on the white vehicle. We look forward to completing the next 2 vans for them.

Visit us at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke to speak to one of our experienced installers about your Commercial van wrap.
